The whole product regression re-ran green on identical product code: build and static checks; unit in two locales; integration 475/475 files; e2e product 572, root acceptance 288 and demo 10 in en (LTR) and ar (RTL); A18 one-archive drill D0-D11 plus harness 10/10; offline drill 10/10; A19 container-free drill R1-R9; A06 replay 28/28; dictionary and init; A26 regression; an A27 re-drill including K11. Every failure in the cited logs is explained. F-DG7-1021 is verified CLOSED_VERIFIED. F-DG7-1022 is REOPENED: the fix is only a disclosure in decisions.md, and the handover and register citations are unchanged. Three new findings: F-DG7-1051 (Medium): the A19 Compose backup half has never been run, while the handover says its result is recorded. F-DG7-1052 (Low): ADR-0063 and ADR-0066 were not amended for the DO-D11 repairs. F-DG7-1053 (Low): a symlinked owner-only backup root is refused with a misleading message. Nothing is Critical, High or mandatory. The verdict is FAIL because F-DG7-1051 is a Medium that must be repaired before the gate (D-192).
